title: Scheduling Standards for In-Person Appointments: Open-Appointment Cap, Same-Day Duplicates and Preventive Intervals
content:
**1. Open-appointment cap.** A new In-Person Appointments booking of a visit type may be made only while the patient's count of open appointments of that same visit type stays below the visit type's limit on open appointments per patient. The count is taken on the handling date and includes every appointment of the patient of that visit type whose status is booked or confirmed. Put as a condition: booking is allowed when the count is less than the limit; when the count equals the limit, the new booking is not made.

**2. Recurring Nurse Visit series.** Where the visit type allows a recurring series (the Nurse Visit), a recurring series may hold up to the visit type's maximum appointments in one series open instead, and the series counts as one series.

**3. No same-day duplicate.** The patient has no other open appointment of the same visit type in the same department on the same scheduled date. The check is made on the system record before the booking, matching the patient, the visit type, the department and the scheduled date; an appointment that is booked, confirmed or checked in on that date counts as open for this check, and a different start time on the same date does not make it a separate appointment for this purpose.

**4. Annual Preventive Exam interval.** An Annual Preventive Exam is booked only on a date at least the visit type's minimum interval in months after the patient's last completed Annual Preventive Exam, counted in calendar months from that visit's scheduled date; where the day-of-month does not exist in the resulting month, the count falls back to that month's last day.

**5. Clinic rebooking.** The cap never blocks a clinic-initiated rebooking of a cancelled visit.

### Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Situation | Count or date | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Established Patient Office Visit, limit 2, one open appointment of that type | 1 below 2 | New booking allowed |
| Same patient, two open appointments of that type | 2 equals 2 | New booking not made |
| Same visit type, same department, second request for the same date at a different time, the first still confirmed | Duplicate | Not booked as a second appointment |
| Last completed Annual Preventive Exam on 2025-02-28, interval 12 months | Earliest date 2026-02-28 | A date of 2026-02-28 qualifies; 2026-02-27 does not |
| Last completed Annual Preventive Exam on 2024-02-29, interval 12 months | No 29 February in 2025 | Falls back to 2025-02-28 |
